title: Stage 5.3 Target-Ratio Spatial Composition — Development Smoke (CMP-0 vs CMP-1)

research_questions.Q1: Does CMP-1 (Primary-Subject Shifted Max-Ratio Crop) keep 100% engineering validity (frame identity, in-bounds, exact target ratio) relative to CMP-0 (Stage 5.1 Frozen Center Crop)?
research_questions.Q2: In which model-blind geometry strata does CMP-1 improve subject visibility, and by how much?
research_questions.Q3: How often does the sanitized primary bbox overflow, and how often does sanitization degenerate (INVALID_SANITIZED_SUBJECT)?

in_scope: CMP-0 = Stage 5.1 Frozen Center Crop (control, verbatim from frozen predictions)
CMP-1 = Primary-Subject Shifted Max-Ratio Crop (position-only single variable)
raw primary bbox sanitization (clamp-into-frame, first version, deterministic)
subject visibility / center containment / crop shift metrics
weak-reference diagnostic (NOT official GT, NOT for model selection)
out_of_scope: zoom / crop scale changes (CMP-1 keeps the maximal legal crop size)
SAM / tracking / motion / Qwen / vLLM / RT-DETR rerun

smoke_manifest.selection_rule: frames = exact frame set of the frozen Stage 5.2 formal policy artifact (30 videos, 450 frames); strata = preregistered horizontal center-offset thresholds on the sanitized Stage 5.2 primary bbox; model-blind; frozen before composition

CMP-0.name: Stage 5.1 Frozen Center Crop
CMP-0.definition: the frozen Stage 5.1 prediction bbox [x, y, w] for the frame, taken verbatim; ratio/rounding contract frozen in stage5_1_center_crop_protocol.json

CMP-1.name: Primary-Subject Shifted Max-Ratio Crop v1
CMP-1.definition: crop size (crop_w, crop_h) = Stage 5.1 maximal legal target-ratio crop via the frozen compute_center_crop; ideal position = floor(sanitized subject center - crop/2); then clamped into bounds; single variable = position
CMP-1.sanitization: x1'=clamp(x1,0,W), y1'=clamp(y1,0,H), x2'=clamp(x2,0,W), y2'=clamp(y2,0,H); if x2'<=x1' or y2'<=y1' then INVALID_SANITIZED_SUBJECT -> CMP-0 fallback; raw bbox is never modified; clamp amounts recorded per side

strata.feature: horizontal center offset |cx/W - 0.5| of the sanitized primary bbox (model-blind geometry)

metrics: engineering counters (frame identity, invalid crop, out-of-bounds, ratio violations, missing, duplicate, sanitized-invalid-unhandled, Stage 5.1 frozen regression, Stage 5.2 artifact modification, Heldout access)
subject_visible_fraction = area(sanitized subject intersect crop) / area(sanitized subject), per CMP-0/CMP-1 with mean/median/P10/P50/P90 and >=0.50/0.75/0.90/0.95/1.00 shares
crop shift distance normalized by frame width/height, per CMP-0/CMP-1
per-stratum visibility comparison (near-center / moderately / strongly / no_subject)
selected-primary overflow audit: frames >0/>1/>3/>5/>10 px; per-direction median/P90/P95/P99/max; sanitized invalid count
weak-reference IoU CMP-0 vs CMP-1 with paired win/tie/loss (diagnostic only)

all_must_pass: deterministic replay = PASS (canonical SHA of all frame records)
Stage 5.1 frozen regression = 0 (CMP-0 boxes == frozen Stage 5.1 predictions)
Stage 5.2 artifact modified = NO (input SHA recheck after run)
official-format emission validated for CMP-0 and CMP-1 (independent validator, 0 violations)
diagnostic mirror cross-check vs frozen PRIMARY decisions: mismatches = 0

behavior_evidence_policy: CMP-1 value is observed in the off-center strata via subject visibility; weak IoU is NEVER a promotion gate (weak reference is center-biased)

visualization.content: frame + raw primary bbox + sanitized bbox + CMP-0 crop + CMP-1 crop + weak reference when present
visualization.media_note: when source videos are unavailable (Windows CPU smoke), figures are GEOMETRY_SCHEMATIC and tagged as such; source-frame figures require the videos root (AutoDL)

next_step_gate: STAGE5_3_FORMAL_PREREGISTRATION only after all primary engineering gates PASS and behavior evidence is reviewed by a human + AI report
